SourceResponse.title: Source, response and field carrier
SourceResponse.statement: A physical field is forced as the complete source-bound map from a localized distinction to every generated accessible response cell; a value detached from source and support is not a field.
SourceResponse.generation_rule: Generate every field carrier, source-response relation, provenance, target access, measurement record, row policy, successor and extra-rule form.
SourceResponse.grammar_boundary: All finite source/response and propagation relations generated from Fold support, exact reference ratios, held orientation and closed transfer without an imported field equation.

choices.name: answer-only-scalar
choices.reason: An answer-only scalar erases the generated physical carrier.

choices.name: complete-fold-carrier
choices.reason: The complete Fold trace retains the observed physical distinction.

choices.name: imported-or-fitted-relation
choices.reason: An imported or fitted relation lets consensus or target data select the law.

choices.name: source-bound-support-map
choices.reason: Only the complete source/support map retains where the distinction arose, where it can be observed and how it propagated.

choices.name: unbound-provenance
choices.reason: Unbound provenance cannot demonstrate which premises produced the result.

choices.name: source-bound-proof-trace
choices.reason: Every generated candidate and decision is bound to its exact source trace.

choices.name: target-readable-prediction
choices.reason: A target-readable predictor can copy or optimize against the measurement.

choices.name: capability-closed-prediction
choices.reason: The registered Fold instruction surface has no target or ambient host capability.

choices.name: proof-measurement-conflation
choices.reason: Treating an external decimal record as a proof scalar violates the measured-value boundary.

choices.name: separate-measurement-record
choices.reason: External values remain source-bound records compared only after sealing.

choices.name: selected-favourable-rows
choices.reason: Selecting favorable rows cannot falsify the relation.

choices.name: complete-registered-rows
choices.reason: Every favorable, unfavorable and tampered registered row is retained.

choices.name: finite-answer-lookup
choices.reason: An answer lookup has no successor certificate.

choices.name: one-successor-closure
choices.reason: The One base and generated successor preserve the relation at every declared finite depth.

choices.name: free-extra-rule
choices.reason: A free constant, scale or exception can select the measured answer.

choices.name: no-extra-rule
choices.reason: No rule beyond the admitted dependencies and forced relation is present.

SourceResponse.exact_result: A field is the complete finite map of a held source distinction through generated accessible support to source-bound response records.
SourceResponse.induction_base: One localized source distinction generates one named response relation on one accessible observation cell.
SourceResponse.induction_step: Adding one generated source or observation cell appends its source-bound response and preserves all prior response, locality and transfer records.
exclusions: action at an ungenerated distance without a propagation trace
negative or floating proof magnitude
imported field equations, fitted couplings or target-selected constants
target access and selected favorable measurements
operational_witnesses: source-response-pair
A source and response retain distinct identities joined by one trace.
closed-transfer
Every transferred field carrier has a named source and destination.

SourceResponse.falsification_condition: The field claim is falsified if any committed external row lacks the predicted source/response or propagation structure, any row is omitted, or the tampered unfavorable row is accepted.
